title: ChemPort Process Schema

textualUnit.description: The original text unit, such as a sentence or passage, from which entities and relations are extracted.

entities.description: List of entities mentioned in the textual unit.

name.description: The name or identifier of the entity, which may be a common name, systematic name, abbreviation, or identifier.

type.description: The normalized type of the entity, indicating whether it is a chemical or a protein/gene.

relations.description: List of relations asserted between entities in the textual unit.

chemicalEntity.description: The name or identifier of the chemical entity involved in the relation.

proteinGeneEntity.description: The name or identifier of the protein/gene entity involved in the relation.

interactionType.description: The type of interaction asserted between the chemical and protein/gene entities.

evidenceText.description: Optional text from the original unit that supports the relation, capturing context, qualifiers, or uncertainty.

description: Schema representing the ChemPort process, capturing entities and their relationships within a textual unit.
